title: Research: sharp eight-call UT4 noncentral pair with arbitrary dirty workspace
body:
## Result

The minimum for PR #1761's noncentral UT4 root pair is **exactly eight paid calls**, including arbitrary finite restored dirty workspace and every nonzero binary rank-one coupling (idempotent or nilpotent).

More generally, for `p` disjoint E13 target roles and `q` disjoint E24 target roles, the sharp separate bounds are

```
n_x >= 2p,  n_y >= 2(p+q),  n_z >= 2q.
```

The direct `xyxy` / `yzyz` coordinate words attain all three bounds. Nonnegative uniform per-label prices therefore give exactly `2p alpha + 2(p+q) beta + 2q gamma`.

This closes #1761's stated five-through-seven gap by a written all-register proof, not a larger finite search. Natural and contragredient representations force `C_xy=C_yx=P`, `C_yz=C_zy=Q`. The **same** middle-label column and row spans must each contain the direct sum of the disjoint target spaces. Their first-order projector sum is zero; rank-nullity then forces `n_y>=2(p+q)`. This is not addition of separate estimates on shared calls.

## Evidence

Only `research/ut4-noncentral-shared-middle/` is added, containing the proof, independent exact representations, complete certificate, source/task/selection/replay metadata and actual validation receipt.

- All 4,096 group products and 4,096 contragredient homomorphism checks.
- All 284 binary rank-one matrices at r=1..4, including 129 nilpotents; 852 formal involutions and 204,672 faithful single-call basis columns.
- All 20,440 two-register words of length0..3 verify coefficient recurrences and span inclusions. This is corroboration, not the universal lower-bound proof.
- 34 full formal/faithful attaining fixtures through eight roles; 8,896 dirty basis columns including two scalar-conjugated targets.
- 18 semantic controls, including omitted calls, dirty workspace restoration, a nonzero formal perturbation killed by both proof representations, a genuine higher-rank shortcut, and a six-call same-role uv witness showing why disjointness is essential.

Executed on CPython **3.12.12**, macOS27 arm64:

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -O -B research/ut4-noncentral-shared-middle/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut4-noncentral-shared-middle
```

Both pass:

```
PASS_UT4_SHARED_MIDDLE pair_minimum=8 witnesses=34 dirty_columns=8896 coefficient_words=20440 controls=18 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/ut4-noncentral-shared-middle outcome=negative-result
```

The coordinating parent separately reviewed the shared-span proof and controls and replayed the registered Python3.12 command before granting publication.

Earlier register-model attribution is retained in the README.
- #1662/#1680/#1690/#1816 concern the different central E14 target. This is not their result restated.
- Targeted final live checks found the cited heads unchanged and #1761's gap still open.

**Scoped formal-algebra theorem; no new kappa or physical supplier.** All roles, allowed free scalar mixing and paid undo are explicit. No address maps, clean allocation or higher-rank calls are free. Physical/compiler/common-label realization, hosting, precision/tape, selected cold replay, outer analytic transfer, Lean and independent human proof review are not supplied. The two proof representations provide necessary conditions only; full-algebra witnesses are checked separately. No selected record, upstream or frozen source is modified.

Prepared for Adam Gall with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance in research, proof, implementation, verification and writing. The two executable representations and parent review are AI-assisted, not independent human verification. Apache-2.0.
